description: Connect your apps so Leo can search and act in them. Each app signs you in on its own page with OAuth 2.0, so Leo never sees your password.

connected.title: Connected
connected.body: You can close this window and return to the dashboard.

denied.title: Access not granted
denied.body: Nothing was connected. You can close this window.

error.title: Couldn’t connect
error.body: Something went wrong while connecting. Try again from Settings.

consent.badge: Demo · no real account is used
consent.title: Connect {app} to Leo?
consent.body: In production, this step is {app}’s own consent screen. Approving lets Leo read and act in your {app} account on your behalf.
consent.bodyUnknown: In production, this step is the provider’s own consent screen. Approving lets Leo read and act in your account on your behalf.
consent.disconnectHint: You can disconnect at any time in Settings › Connectors.
